observations: Read only TARGET.md, index.json and the 31 named actual PNGs in this report. Inspected PNGs with view_image at their supplied native dimensions; no montages, source code, Builder explanations or peer reports were used.

Covered Parent ready, active, paused, stopped and expired cards at all four viewport anchors, plus active page tops at all four anchors; covered Child exhausted, Parent-stopped, renewed and four-anchor active library countdowns.

Navigation labels and active Time treatment are legible across desktop sidebar, tablet top navigation and phone navigation. Parent phone icon-only switch-profile control is less explicit than the desktop label, but secondary.

White Parent cards, dark ink navigation, lavender emphasis and restrained peach stop action form a coherent family product. Child library is comfortably dark and uses clear section headings and large filter controls.

Custom minutes has an explicit label, 1–240 whole-minute instruction and a visible focus ring. The selected duration is repeated in the Save label. Ready, active, paused, expired and Parent-stopped text are differentiated in the header.

Renewal time, family timezone, no rollover, start on child library use and wall-clock background behavior are explained. Parent block copy explicitly says removing a time limit does not unlock access; Allow access is separately labeled. Exhausted daily state offers Add 5 minutes today.

Primary and outlined controls have consistent rounded shapes and readable labels. Observed button heights are generally about 46–50 pixels. No visible horizontal overflow, clipped control labels or overlapping text occurs in the inspected Parent card captures.

Child exhausted screen says renewal is at 7 AM; Parent-stopped screen says Parent will let the child know. Choose profile and Ask Parent provide visible navigation/recovery routes. Active countdown Daily time · 1 min left is readable at each anchor.

Parent controls have excessive vertical friction for ongoing-session management: setup, presets and repeated rules precede every Pause/Resume/End/access recovery control. This is a material hierarchy defect described below.

material_defects.title: Current-session actions are buried below recurring configuration at every anchor
evidence: 390x844 active-top: card begins around y386; active-card End now begins around local y750 and Pause around local y862, placing both far below the initial viewport.
1024x768 active-top: card begins at y400; active-card End now begins around local y660 and Pause around local y718. Neither current-session action is in the initial landscape viewport.
768x1024 active-top: card begins at y400; active-card End now begins around local y753 and Pause around local y865, below the initial portrait viewport.

1440x1000 active-top: card begins around y348; active-card End now begins around local y660 and Pause around local y718. Even desktop initially exposes setup/save while hiding the operational actions.
Paused and Parent-blocked cards retain the same ordering: Resume or Allow access follows the entire form, presets and explanatory paragraphs.
material_defects.impact: A Parent arriving to stop, pause, resume or recover access must scroll through settings before the action becomes visible. The largest Save daily allowance action dominates even when the job is managing the active window. This materially slows the central timer task on the primary phone and iPad targets.
material_defects.required_result: Place state-dependent session actions with the child identity and remaining/saved time, ahead of daily configuration; retain clear separation from editing and saving recurring allowance. Rerun the exact candidate at all four anchors after changing the hierarchy.

optional_improvements: Use a compact or expandable rules explanation to reduce repeated reading burden while retaining the important behavior.

Give preset buttons a clearer button affordance/selected treatment; current muted standalone labels can be mistaken for disabled choices. Screenshots alone do not establish their actual enabled state.
Display America/New_York in a more familiar human-readable form while preserving the exact timezone meaning.
Consider showing Ask Parent directly beside Choose profile on the exhausted/blocked card, although the global Ask Parent navigation is already visible.
limits: Scoped static rendered UI verdict only; synthetic authorized Chromium fixtures, not hosted database or physical-device proof.

No backend enforcement, actual renewal/pause/block persistence, keyboard traversal, screen-reader semantics, computed contrast ratios, native fullscreen, picture/sound, touch accuracy or real-device behavior certified.
Visible focus, control size and contrast judged visually, not through DOM or measurement instrumentation.
Long Child screenshots show fixed phone navigation at viewport height; its appearance over the full-page capture is not independently treated as a blocking defect without scroll interaction evidence.
No independent Child-paused screenshot was supplied/consumed; no claim is made about its appearance.
